## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_火. Core element Water, energy element Fire. Law: Water tames Fire (水克火: rain ends the blaze). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Fire is this core's Action.
- Family personas and ruled domains (the cost domain: the cost is named in these words or in ordinary life, work only where a domain word is work; the definition names one drive per persona, E8): The Horizon: Opportunity, Ventures, Father · The Steward: Wealth, Savings, Steady love

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 水能克火，火多水热 (克之不逮, the Action door).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Fire as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel; the friction pole of Fire as the Action is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill, cure set Water (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, wide, missing, spared, thin, excess. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

mechanism.base.value: Water puts out fire, the old texts say, the way the many overcome the few: rain falls on the blaze until the ground goes dark and quiet. Fire gives the water its work. Over a flame the cold deep warms, moves and has somewhere to go. Water with no heat under it only sits, and heat with nothing deep enough to meet it spends itself on the air and is gone by morning.

spec.notes: opens on a plain statement of the state in the reader's terms (Fire named, its volume in ordinary words, the reference lead-in "With too little Fire, …" or any plain statement, never "Run thin," or "Run heavy,"), then the elemental image of the state in one clause that stands alone, what it costs, then ONE plain directive that stands alone, the carry line below is cut from the image clause

spec.construct: THE THREE BEATS (owner 2026-10-14, D14, function first). Beat 1, the first sentence, is this function's fixed sentence, word for word: "Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide." (the function for anyone; the gate blocks any other first sentence). Beat 2, one sentence: what Fire makes of your Action, Fire as the agent with its plain verb or state (E7), ending on what that does to the function for this reader; no amount of Fire, no pole. Beat 3, one or two sentences opening on "As a catalyst,": what the shortfall does to the function, then the family's two drives as one either-or (the tension sentence, D9, both personas inside it, E8), the cost as the close (D11, the reader its subject). NEVER an amount of the element anywhere in the definition ("more Earth than", "little Water", "Metal to spare", "runs thin": the gate blocks them; the bars will carry the amount); never the old opener "{Element} is your {Function}, and as a …" (the title line above the definition already says it). Three or four sentences, 30 to 50 words.
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry anywhere in it as the energy's plain verb or state, or the energy's name in the mechanism sentence ("There is more Fire in you than you use"): Fire's or Water's (flows, pours, settles; grows, builds, reaches; warm, light, fuel; holds, shelters, steady; hard, exact, finishes); never a prop (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, branch, root, stream, flame, heat, burn are blocked and do not count); the element's name in the opener does not count; the gate blocks without it (owner 2026-09-30, narrowed 2026-10-14)
spec.opener: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide.
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (the gate blocks a definition without it)
spec.notes: the family's two drives in one either-or, one clause per persona with its cost, anchored in that persona's ruled domain words, in two or three sentences (no inventory, owner 2026-10-14, polish rule 4); the mechanism sentence is required in a definition and names Fire and its volume in ordinary words. The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

function.definition_friction.value: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire turns it bright, lit the moment a chance appears. As a friction, the light outruns its fuel, and you chase a new opening rather than keep what you have. You end up starting more than you can feed.

spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_catalyst.value: You feel safer planning a thing than starting it, and the plan is where most of your chances end. Put a date on one venture and begin before it arrives. Ask for the raise instead of waiting for it. Tell the person you love what you want next. Once a week, buy the small thing you keep pricing.

spec.remedy_shape: THE REMEDY (owner 2026-10-14): the friction advice renders under its own title, THE REMEDY, after the ledger, and OPENS on the energy prescription beat: "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The beat is the first sentence of the field (the gate blocks any other opening); the one plain truth sentence and the two small life actions follow it, in the cure's register; the field closes on the last action, never on a second beat.
spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Action is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), two, in the cure's register (owner 2026-10-14, Q35: on an Order cure someone above you, a deadline, a judge, never a friend; on a Mind cure study, shelter, time; on an Action cure a thing made or shipped; on a Body cure sleep, food, rest; on an Expression cure a thing said or given), the smallest action last, closing on the energy prescription in the energy-manual register (owner 2026-09-29, the beat re-cut 2026-09-30): "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_friction.value: Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from: sleep, food, the slow fill that comes before anything is lit. Let it hold what Fire burns. You spend yourself on every bright chance because stopping feels like losing. Keep one night a week unlit, in bed early. Eat before you say yes to anything.

spec.pole_neutral: one verdict per pair, rendered on this page whichever pole the chart shows (this batch writes both poles), so it must read true on both: what Fire as your Action IS, never its state, no heavy, thin, too much, too little, running over, running short
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (noted on a verdict, the read decides)
spec.notes: explains "Fire is your Action": a behavioural truth with the reader as its subject plus ONE tendency-framed consequence beat, true on either pole, the tension inside the one sentence where it can be; at least eight words, no arena word, no turn word (but, yet, however), no more than two commas (owner 2026-10-14, v0.7.1)

cta_verdict.value: You act on warmth rather than on a plan, and what you start fast is what you most need help keeping.
cta_verdict.value_b: You give in bursts rather than on a schedule, and what you provide is remembered by how often it comes back.
